items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: My mother said Cherokee and Ann, but I don't remember the number just now.

ctx.x: Remember just the street and the number?

My mother said Cherokee and Ann, but I don't remember the number just now. I attended pay school, what they called pay school then, before ever going to grammar school. And I started in grammar school at Tom LeFont School.
Was that one of the public schools?
